events.description: 7. ORDER signed by Magistrate Judge Carolyn K. Delaney on 10/7/2024 DENYING 4 Motion for Sanctions without prejudice, DENYING 5 Motion for Electronic Filing, and GRANTING 6 Motion for Extension of Time. Plaintiff shall have until 10/7/2024 to file his First Amended Complaint. The Court is amenable to allowing Plaintiff to receive service of documents by electronic means. Plaintiff may file a request with the Clerk of Court to receive service of documents at his email address. If Plaintiff files such a request, the Clerk is directed to configure Plaintiff's account so that he will receive immediate email notifications when documents are filed in the case. (Mendez Licea, O) Modified on 10/15/2024 (Mendez Licea, O). (Entered: 10/07/2024)
